title: Public Sector Leadership
description: Public leadership requires an understanding of others and one's self in order to mobilize effort in challenging environments. Provides frameworks and practical strategies for understanding personal capacity, team dynamics, and working with others within and across organizational boundaries. Introduces students to competing values and ethics, and equips them with skills and strategies for analyzing, motivating and managing change and the challenges they may face.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ADMN 507, DR 511, PADR 503, PADR 504.
